summary: Iteration 38: Comprehensive testing of MAARS Command platform - Markdown rendering, Admin controls (toggle permissions, brain save), Image generation with Nano Banana 2, and Signup flow. All features working correctly after CORS fix.

TestAdminLogin.test_admin_login_success: PASSED - Admin login with management.maars@marsgc.net works

TestAdminTogglePermissions.test_toggle_can_generate_image: PASSED - Toggle OFF/ON works via PUT /api/admin/agents/{id}/settings

TestAdminBrainSave.test_save_agent_brain: PASSED - Brain config saved via PUT /api/admin/agents/{id}/brain

TestChatMessaging.test_create_chat_and_send_message: PASSED - Chat creation and AI response works

TestImageGenerationAgent.test_send_image_request_to_graphic_agent: PASSED - Image generated via Nano Banana 2 (gemini-3-pro-image-preview)

frontend_tests.admin_login: PASSED - Login form fills correctly, redirect to dashboard
frontend_tests.markdown_rendering: PASSED - React-markdown with remark-gfm renders headers, bullet lists, bold text, inline code correctly
frontend_tests.admin_dashboard: PASSED - Admin Control Panel loads with Overview, Analytics, Users, Agents, Transactions, Pricing tabs
frontend_tests.admin_agents_tab: PASSED - Shows 21 agents with IMG/PDF/FILES toggle badges
frontend_tests.admin_toggle_img: PASSED - Clicking IMG toggle shows 'Disabled image generation' toast
frontend_tests.admin_agent_expand: PASSED - Agent row expands showing Generation Permissions (Images, Videos, PDF, Files) toggles
frontend_tests.admin_brain_editor: PASSED - Brain Editor modal opens with Name, Role, Description, Personality & Tone, Expertise Areas, Do's/Don'ts, Knowledge Base, Model Provider/Name, Temperature, Max Tokens fields and Save Brain button

markdown_rendering.details: MarkdownRenderer component uses react-markdown with remark-gfm. Renders: h1/h2/h3 headers with custom styling, ul/ol lists with disc/decimal markers, strong (bold) text in white, inline code with emerald color and rounded background, code blocks with zinc-900 background, blockquotes with indigo border, tables with proper styling

image_generation_nano_banana_2.details: Image generation triggered for agent_graphics (Felix Romano). Backend log confirms: 'Generated image via Nano Banana 2'. Uses emergentintegrations with gemini-3-pro-image-preview model and modalities=['image', 'text']

admin_toggle_permissions.details: PUT /api/admin/agents/{agent_id}/settings endpoint works. Frontend toggle buttons (IMG, PDF, FILES, Active) call handleToggleCapability which sends toggle request. Toast shows success message ('Disabled image generation'/'Enabled image generation')

admin_brain_save.details: PUT /api/admin/agents/{agent_id}/brain endpoint works. Brain Editor modal provides full configuration: personality_tone, expertise_areas, dos, donts, knowledge_base, model_provider, model_name, temperature, max_tokens. Save Brain button persists changes to database

cors_fix_verified.details: CORS fix (removing credentials: include from fetch calls) confirmed working. Admin toggle buttons now work in frontend UI without CORS errors

signup_flow.details: POST /api/auth/register endpoint works for new user registration

seed_data_creation: Test chats and tasks cleaned up after testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested features verified working: (1) Markdown rendering in chat uses react-markdown with remark-gfm - headers, lists, bold, code all render correctly. (2) Image generation with Nano Banana 2 (gemini-3-pro-image-preview) works for graphic designer agent. (3) Admin toggle permissions work after CORS fix - toggle buttons in Agents tab send PUT requests successfully. (4) Admin brain save works - Brain Editor modal provides full customization. (5) Signup flow works. The CORS fix involved removing 'credentials: include' from frontend fetch calls.

mocked_integrations.note: Third-party integrations (Slack, Airtable, Calendly) are MOCKED - the admin UI exists to configure API keys but backend logic to USE saved API keys is not implemented
